title: JudgeCast: Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Informed Covariate Judgements
abstract: arXiv:2609.36966v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Covariate effects vary across contexts and shift over time, requiring forecasters to assess how to use them for each forecasting context. As forecasting proceeds, observations for earlier forecasts become available, providing feedback on past covariate use for subsequent forecasts. However, when multiple covariates act together, the forecast error reveals the numerical discrepancy from the observation but not how the covariates should have been used. We introduce JudgeCast, an experience-based framework for time series forecasting with covariates. Following the judgmental adjustment practice, a frozen TSFM provides the base forecast, while a frozen LLM uses the current context and relevant experience to adjust it. Within the adjustment, assessing covariate effects and determining the numerical adjustment serve distinct roles, so JudgeCast first forms explicit covariate-wise judgments and then determines the adjustment. translated_title: JudgeCast：基于经验信息协变量判断的时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 协变量效应因情境而异，并随时间推移而变化，这要求预测者针对每个预测情境评估如何使用这些协变量。随着预测的进行，早期预测对应的观测值逐渐可得，为后续预测中协变量的使用提供了反馈。然而，当多个协变量共同作用时，预测误差仅能揭示与观测值之间的数值偏差，而无法说明协变量本应如何被使用。我们提出了JudgeCast，一个基于经验的协变量时间序列预测框架。遵循判断性调整的实践，一个冻结的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）提供基础预测，而一个冻结的大语言模型（LLM）则利用当前情境和相关经验对其进行调整。在调整过程中，评估协变量效应与确定数值调整扮演着不同的角色，因此JudgeCast首先形成显式的逐协变量判断，然后再确定具体的调整量。在观测……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出JudgeCast框架，由冻结的时间序列基础模型提供基础预测，冻结的大语言模型结合当前情境与历史经验先形成显式的逐协变量判断、再确定调整量，从而实现基于经验反馈的协变量时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: JudgeCast is an experience-based time series forecasting framework in which a frozen LLM leverages the current context and accumulated experience to form explicit covariate-wise judgements and adjust base forecasts produced by a frozen time series foundation model.
